description: This header file declares functions, macros, and external variables related to the MeshAgent component in a network management system. It provides APIs for getting, setting, validating, committing, and rolling back configuration parameters for the Mesh Agent and associated features.

methods.name: CosaDmlServiceManagerInit
methods.description: Initializes the service manager for the MeshAgent component.

methods.name: MeshAgent_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the MeshAgent.

methods.name: OVS_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets the boolean value of the OVS parameter.

methods.name: XleAdaptiveFh_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets the boolean value of the XleAdaptiveFh parameter.

methods.name: GreAcc_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets the boolean value of the GreAcc parameter.

methods.name: MeshAgent_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for the MeshAgent.

methods.name: MeshAgent_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value.

methods.name: MeshAgent_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value.

methods.name: MeshAgent_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the MeshAgent.

methods.name: OVS_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets the boolean value of the OVS parameter.

methods.name: XleAdaptiveFh_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets the boolean value of the XleAdaptiveFh parameter.

methods.name: GreAcc_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets the boolean value of the GreAcc parameter.

methods.name: MeshAgent_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the configuration to the previous state.
